== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Ralltiir (Japanese)|Ralltiir]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67694 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(40, 16, 440, 618)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>822343442e2216600d2bafc3a2e0f9e843611cd121720844783f569e118b43a8</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
